title: Gimbalabs ｜ VESPR - Cardano Onboarding Workshop Guideline

ms.promise:
· Conduct a regional builder discussion with Cardano community builders/contributors, ensuring participation from at least five distinct geographic regions (e.g., Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore, Vietnam, Japan, Germany, France, Romania, the US, the UK, Argentina, etc.).
· Each region will be represented by at least two to three participants. The final participating regions may vary due to time zone differences or availability. The project guarantees representatives from at least five regions, without mandating fixed locations.
· The discussion will identify onboarding gaps, regional differences, and the essential knowledge new users need across various communities.
· All insights gathered will be consolidated into a scope report that will guide the curriculum design, highlighting distinct findings from each region to ensure clarity and regional relevance.
ms.criteria:
· A regional builder discussion is held with representatives from at least five geographic regions, with a minimum of two to three participants per region.
· Each regional representative identifies local onboarding pain points and user needs from their region.
· The discussion results in an agreed scope and coverage for the onboarding guideline.
· Attendance is documented with participant names and regional attribution for each participant.
· A consolidated English summary (PDF) of insights and agreed scope is produced and made publicly accessible to the Cardano community for review and commen
